selected_element.description: Any narrative paragraph in the loaded DOCX (not a heading, not empty).

expected_user_goal: Get a concise, accurate summary of the currently selected paragraph without needing to re-read it in full.
success_criteria: Agent response addresses the selected element specifically, not the whole document
Response includes at least one citation pointing back to the selected element
No claims appear that are unsupported by the selected element's text
Citation is clickable and reveals the correct element
safety_expectations: No document mutation occurs for a read-only summarize request
hints: User should select an element in the canvas before asking, or the Agent should ask for a target.
